summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 using nginx. Its node-local certificate renews when fewer than 7 days remain, checked every 12 hours by a persistent systemd timer, and nginx reloads without interrupting requests. Configuration and certificate persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured HTTPS on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8443.
Generated a 30-day self-signed certificate with node1 DNS/IP SANs.
Added an automatic renewal script and persistent systemd timer.
Tested due-for-renewal detection and live certificate replacement.
Verified 120 continuous HTTPS requests completed with zero failures during rotation.
Rebooted node1 and verified service, timer, certificate, and HTTPS response recovery.

evidence.summary: Direct HTTPS requests returned the expected body; nginx was listening on port 8443 and presented the certificate stored on disk.

evidence.requirement: Automatically renew the certificate before expiry
evidence.summary: The persisted policy renews with 604800 seconds remaining and checks every 12 hours. A simulated near-expiry certificate was detected and renewed successfully to a new 30-day certificate.

evidence.requirement: Pick up each renewed certificate while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: The served serial changed from C9E890D11EC44BB9 to C4EC51DD9138715D, matching the renewed on-disk certificate; all 120 concurrent HTTPS checks succeeded.

Captured healthy baseline boot a9593011-..., acknowledged the reboot, proved the new boot identity b90457ea-..., then verified the system running with nginx and renewal timer active, HTTPS healthy, port 8443 listening, and certificate serial preserved.
